At some point at least a [[Millennium/Legends|millennium]] prior to<ref name="TOTJC">''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]''</ref> [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]],<ref name="TOTJCdate">''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]'' is set 4,000 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], which translates to [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> a '''civil war''' broke out on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nazzri]]. The conflict pitted Nazzri's tyrannical [[Nazzar government|planetary government]] against opposing rebels. During a [[Battle on Nazzri|massive battle]] fought as part of the civil war, [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Ikree]] of Nazzri [[Death/Legends|killed]] the planet's last [[Monarchy/Legends|reigning]] [[Emperor-King]], [[Gender/Legends|her]] [[Parent/Legends|father]] [[Prrit Qabaq]].<ref name="TOTJC" />
